evals.prompt: Make a visual report explaining when a background job retries and when it stops. Keep the implementation detail optional.
evals.expected_output: An HTML visual report; no video, narration, or FFrames work.

evals.prompt: Make a narrated video explainer about when a background job retries and when it stops. Show the decision clearly and give me the MP4.
evals.expected_output: A source-backed scene plan, measured narration, rendered MP4, captions, descriptive transcript, and editable project.

evals.prompt: Explain retry limits in both an HTML visual report and a short narrated video. Use the same facts for both.
evals.expected_output: Both formats, with a shared factual brief and separate HTML and video validation.
